from __future__ import annotations
import pandas as pd
p='opsd_de_load.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p)
print(df.shape)
print(df.columns.tolist())
print(df.head(2).to_string(index=False))
print(df.tail(2).to_string(index=False))
print(df.isna().sum().to_dict())
ts=pd.to_datetime(df['utc_timestamp'], utc=True)
print(ts.min(), ts.max())
print('hour gaps ok', (ts.diff().dropna()==pd.Timedelta(hours=1)).all())
print('rows', len(df))

from __future__ import annotations
import importlib, time
for name in ['pmdarima','lightgbm','holidays','statsmodels','darts','darts.models','torch','pytorch_lightning','prophet']:
    t=time.time()

        mod=importlib.import_module(name)
        print(name, 'OK', getattr(mod, '__version__', 'no-version'), f'{time.time()-t:.2f}s')
    except Exception as exc:
        print(name, 'ERR', type(exc).__name__, str(exc), f'{time.time()-t:.2f}s')
